items.text:
Just found this sub, hoping someone would be willing to help me out
So quick bit of background and why i have this request.  So i’m 21 about to graduate from college, something unique about me is that instead of daydreaming about plans, past events, or the future I daydream in stories.  There’s one particular (fantasy esque) world i’ve had running in my head for years, but one particular story in this world really stood out from the rest, thought up this part during a very dark time in my life.  Recently i looked back on it and thought about how great the actual story was (the dark tone, compelling characters, the redemption arc one of the main characters has to go through) and the idea came into my head that I should write the story out before i forget it like i have earlier sections of the world.  So that’s exactly what i’m doing, i’m taking a writing class next semester, started really looking at how authors write and describe situations in books, writing down the details about landmarks, religions, cultures, events that happen in the book, significant characters, the creatures.  So right now i’m hoping someone might be interested in helping me create some concept art for my favorite character in it, let me know if anyone is interested.  I’m really excited about the idea of sharing this story and would really appreciate any help.
What types of drawings are you the best at?  I have a lot of stuff haha

I’m still working out some of the more complex details of the world before i actually write it down on paper, but the gyst of the story is that it takes place on a world with high oxygen resulting in most of the creatures on the planet to become very large and aggressive.  As a result humans are no longer the apex predator of the world and manage to survive in heavily fortified castles.  Due to these creatures reproducing at an unprecedented rate and increased attacks, the empire that rules over the land where this takes place is on the brink of collapse.  The first chapter opens with a group of prospectors searching for a caravan from a robbery gone wrong.  Rumor says that an earthquake caused a fissure to open and swallow the caravan before the robbers could take what they wanted.  The group descends into the fissure and finds a strange ancient looking door with an incredibly alien design and structure carved into the cavern wall next to the wreckage.  The enter and begin to investigate, the structure is a labyrinth of these strange narrow tunnels damaged from an untold amount of time underground.  All except for these strange suits of armor standing along the walls, silver, extremely elegant in design, and holding a something resembling a staff, designed with the same elegance and complexity of the armor, across their body.   These strange suits dotting the dark tunnels are the only thing not completely ruined by time, looking almost new.  It isn’t long before they realize something in the tunnels is watching them and the prospectors start to disappear one by one.  Their stalker unseen and unheard until the sound of scrapping metal pierces the darkness dragging another one of their party into it.  The chapter ends with only two of their original 8 remaining, finding themselves in a large rectangular room lines with these statues lining the room and lit by four torches at each corner of the room, at the end of the room on an elevated floor of sorts stairs leading up to it is a large stone box standing up against a wall about 7 feet in height and 2 in width.  Covered in strange runes all converging on a circular indent on the center of the box.  (Still working out the details of what they do with the box, but they open the box).  They step back as the stone doors swing open and an old decrepit starved looking man, with more of the appearance of a corpse than a living person, stumbles out of the box and falls.  Two of the silver suits to each side of the box spring to life catch the old man before he hits the ground both remaining prospectors watch in horror before cold metal closes around their necks from behind.  The next chapter opens with 6 of the 8 prospectors chained to the wall of a circular room, the old man standing in the center of them, looking a bit less like a corpse, watching them intently.  A door to a lit hallway was behind him where the screams seemed to never end.
